title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin trades at sixty-three thousand five hundred seventy-six dollars after a two-point-one percent drop, with the Fear and Greed index locked at twenty-nine. US morning flows stayed defensive as spot volume thinned and no major catalysts emerged. On-chain, hashrate holds firm at eight hundred seventy-nine point eight EH/s, signaling miner conviction despite the dip. Mempool sits at one hundred three thousand transactions with the fastest fee at just two sat per vbyte, pointing to light conges
